verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents its own export capabilities: a project event-data export API, cohort export, and dashboard chart data in JSON through the Dashboard REST API. That covers the core raw data and some derived data, but nothing shows a complete, all-data export or confirms the event export uses an open format. The BigQuery and Snowflake directory entries only describe those partner products, so they are not credited as export evidence. Missing for 10: proof that all data (session replays, experiments, taxonomy, dashboards) can be exported, an explicit open file format for the event export, documented bulk or warehouse export paths, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Get data that's displayed on the dashboard graphs in JSON format through the Dashboard REST API.
